motion_rule: he never stops: a full sprint from the first frame, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the walls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; his head fills half the frame height, head-on and closer from 6.9; new shot size each beat
character: a rangy grey wolf in a cheap frayed office jacket, yellow eyes, teeth bared
second_characters: ONE lean grey mouse in a green visor riding his shoulder, flinging blank pay slips at the lens
props: ONE translucent glowing pay envelope flying at his nose height, nothing printed on it; blank pay slips the mouse flings
prop_continuity: the envelope stays translucent and glowing all clip, is never held, and nothing ever touches it solidly; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a long office corridor, grey pay windows and filing walls both sides to the ceiling, hard noon sun through the skylights
light_events: skylight bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides, the envelope flares at 9.2

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.4 one breath; pause 2.4-3.0; 3.0-5.5 one breath; pause 5.5-6.1; 6.1-7.7 one breath; after 7.7 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: claws hammering the floor all clip, a paper storm, a drawer banging on each lunge, a hollow airy shimmer whenever his teeth pass through the envelope

timeline.a: the frame opens tight on his jaws snapping shut on the glowing envelope and closing straight through it, and he is already at a full sprint, pay windows tearing past
he swipes a paw at the envelope and it slips through his claws, and he digs harder, the walls streaking backwards
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, and drops back into the corridor still driving hard
he drives head on at the lens and the mouse rides his shoulder flinging blank slips across the lens
his jaws snap at the envelope twice at full drive and close through it both times, slips wiping the lens
he bursts head first through a wall stack of pay slips into the lens, paper blowing apart around his head
the envelope cuts sideways and he slams after it, shoulder raking the filing wall, still driving
he shoulders a drawer open and it bangs past his ear, the envelope glowing at his muzzle, still driving
the mouse leaps off his shoulder through the envelope and lands running, and he drives on at the lens
he rams a drawer shut with his shoulder and drives on, the filing walls tearing past
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, and the envelope hangs whole and glowing inside them with a blank slip caught in his teeth

must_appear: he throws himself into the lens with his jaws wide at 2.4, 5.5 and 9.2; at 9.2 the envelope hangs whole inside his open jaws with a blank slip caught in his teeth; the mouse rides his shoulder flinging pay slips at 3.0 and leaps through the envelope at 7.7
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, duplicate props, foreign accent, slow speech, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped hero, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, readable text, human hands, extra limbs, a solid opaque envelope, teeth denting the envelope, speech after 7.7
